verses.textZh: 神和主耶稣基督的仆人雅各，向散居各地的十二支派问安。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神和主耶稣基督的仆人雅各，向散居各地的十二支派问安。
verses.textZhCuv: 作神和主耶稣基督仆人的雅各请散住十二个支派之人的安。
verses.textEnNiv: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, To the twelve tribes scattered among the nations: Greetings.
verses.textEnEsv: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, To the twelve tribes in the Dispersion: Greetings.
verses.textEnNkjv: James, a bondservant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, To the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad: Greetings.
verses.textEnNlt: This letter is from James, a slave of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ. I am writing to the "twelve tribes"—Jewish believers scattered abroad. Greetings!
verses.textEnNasb: James, a bond-servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, To the twelve tribes who are dispersed abroad: Greetings.
verses.textEn: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, To the twelve tribes scattered among the nations: Greetings.

verses.textZh: 我的弟兄们，你们遭遇各种试炼的时候，都要看为喜乐；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的弟兄们，你们遭遇各种试炼的时候，都要看为喜乐；
verses.textZhCuv: 我的弟兄们，你们落在百般试炼中，都要以为大喜乐；
verses.textEnNiv: Consider it pure joy, my brothers and sisters, whenever you face trials of many kinds,
verses.textEnEsv: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you meet trials of various kinds,
verses.textEnNkjv: My brethren, count it all joy when you fall into various trials,
verses.textEnNlt: Dear brothers and sisters, when troubles of any kind come your way, consider it an opportunity for great joy.
verses.textEnNasb: Consider it all joy, my brothers and sisters, when you encounter various trials,
verses.textEn: Consider it pure joy, my brothers and sisters, whenever you face trials of many kinds,

verses.textZh: 因为知道你们的信心经过考验，就产生忍耐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为知道你们的信心经过考验，就产生忍耐。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为知道你们的信心经过试验，就生忍耐。
verses.textEnNiv: because you know that the testing of your faith produces perseverance.
verses.textEnEsv: for you know that the testing of your faith produces steadfastness.
verses.textEnNkjv: knowing that the testing of your faith produces patience.
verses.textEnNlt: For you know that when your faith is tested, your endurance has a chance to grow.
verses.textEnNasb: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.
verses.textEn: because you know that the testing of your faith produces perseverance.

verses.textZh: 但忍耐要坚持到底 ，使你们可以完全，毫无缺乏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但忍耐要坚持到底 ，使你们可以完全，毫无缺乏。
verses.textZhCuv: 但忍耐也当成功，使你们成全、完备，毫无缺欠。
verses.textEnNiv: Let perseverance finish its work so that you may be mature and complete, not lacking anything.
verses.textEnEsv: And let steadfastness have its full effect, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.
verses.textEnNkjv: But let patience have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking nothing.
verses.textEnNlt: So let it grow, for when your endurance is fully developed, you will be perfect and complete, needing nothing.
verses.textEnNasb: And let endurance have its perfect result, so that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.
verses.textEn: Let perseverance finish its work so that you may be mature and complete, not lacking anything.

verses.textZh: 你们中间若有人缺少智慧，就当向那厚赐众人，而且不斥责人的神祈求，他就必得着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们中间若有人缺少智慧，就当向那厚赐众人，而且不斥责人的神祈求，他就必得着。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们中间若有缺少智慧的，应当求那厚赐与众人、也不斥责人的神，主就必赐给他。
verses.textEnNiv: If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to you.
verses.textEnEsv: If any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask God, who gives generously to all without reproach, and it will be given him.
verses.textEnNkjv: If any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.
verses.textEnNlt: If you need wisdom, ask our generous God, and he will give it to you. He will not rebuke you for asking.
verses.textEnNasb: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all generously and without reproach, and it will be given to him.
verses.textEn: If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to you.

verses.textZh: 可是，他应该凭着信心祈求，不要有疑惑；因为疑惑的人，就像被风吹荡翻腾的海浪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是，他应该凭着信心祈求，不要有疑惑；因为疑惑的人，就像被风吹荡翻腾的海浪。
verses.textZhCuv: 只要凭着信心求，一点不疑惑；因为那疑惑的人，就像海中的波浪，被风吹动翻腾。
verses.textEnNiv: But when you ask, you must believe and not doubt, because the one who doubts is like a wave of the sea, blown and tossed by the wind.
verses.textEnEsv: But let him ask in faith, with no doubting, for the one who doubts is like a wave of the sea that is driven and tossed by the wind.
verses.textEnNkjv: But let him ask in faith, with no doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea driven and tossed by the wind.
verses.textEnNlt: But when you ask him, be sure that your faith is in God alone. Do not waver, for a person with divided loyalty is as unsettled as a wave of the sea that is blown and tossed by the wind.
verses.textEnNasb: But he must ask in faith without any doubting, for the one who doubts is like the surf of the sea, driven and tossed by the wind.
verses.textEn: But when you ask, you must believe and not doubt, because the one who doubts is like a wave of the sea, blown and tossed by the wind.

verses.textZh: 那样的人，不要想从主得到甚么；
verses.textZhCnvs: 那样的人，不要想从主得到甚么；
verses.textZhCuv: 这样的人不要想从主那里得什么。
verses.textEnNiv: That person should not expect to receive anything from the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: For that person must not suppose that he will receive anything from the Lord;
verses.textEnNkjv: For let not that man suppose that he will receive anything from the Lord;
verses.textEnNlt: Such people should not expect to receive anything from the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: For that person ought not to expect that he will receive anything from the Lord,
verses.textEn: That person should not expect to receive anything from the Lord.

verses.textZh: 因为三心两意的人，在他的一切道路上，都摇摆不定。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为三心两意的人，在他的一切道路上，都摇摆不定。
verses.textZhCuv: 心怀二意的人，在他一切所行的路上都没有定见。
verses.textEnNiv: Such a person is double-minded and unstable in all they do.
verses.textEnEsv: he is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
verses.textEnNkjv: heis a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
verses.textEnNlt: Their loyalty is divided between God and the world, and they are unstable in everything they do.
verses.textEnNasb: being a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
verses.textEn: Such a person is double-minded and unstable in all they do.

verses.textZh: 卑微的弟兄应当以高升为荣；
verses.textZhCnvs: 卑微的弟兄应当以高升为荣；
verses.textZhCuv: 卑微的弟兄升高，就该喜乐；
verses.textEnNiv: Believers in humble circumstances ought to take pride in their high position.
verses.textEnEsv: Let the lowly brother boast in his exaltation,
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the lowly brother glory in his exaltation,
verses.textEnNlt: Believers who are poor have something to boast about, for God has honored them.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the brother or sister of humble circumstances is to glory in his high position;
verses.textEn: Believers in humble circumstances ought to take pride in their high position.

verses.textZh: 富足的也不应该以降卑为辱；因为他如同草上的花，必要过去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 富足的也不应该以降卑为辱；因为他如同草上的花，必要过去。
verses.textZhCuv: 富足的降卑，也该如此；因为他必要过去，如同草上的花一样。
verses.textEnNiv: But the rich should take pride in their humiliation—since they will pass away like a wild flower.
verses.textEnEsv: and the rich in his humiliation, because like a flower of the grass he will pass away.
verses.textEnNkjv: but the rich in his humiliation, because as a flower of the field he will pass away.
verses.textEnNlt: And those who are rich should boast that God has humbled them. They will fade away like a little flower in the field.
verses.textEnNasb: but the rich person is to glory in his humiliation, because like flowering grass he will pass away.
verses.textEn: But the rich should take pride in their humiliation—since they will pass away like a wild flower.

verses.textZh: 太阳一出，热风一吹，草必枯干，花必凋谢，它的美容就消失了；富足的人也必在他的奔波经营中这样衰落。
verses.textZhCnvs: 太阳一出，热风一吹，草必枯干，花必凋谢，它的美容就消失了；富足的人也必在他的奔波经营中这样衰落。
verses.textZhCuv: 太阳出来，热风刮起，草就枯干，花也凋谢，美容就消没了；那富足的人，在他所行的事上也要这样衰残。
verses.textEnNiv: For the sun rises with scorching heat and withers the plant; its blossom falls and its beauty is destroyed. In the same way, the rich will fade away even while they go about their business.
verses.textEnEsv: For the sun rises with its scorching heat and withers the grass; its flower falls, and its beauty perishes. So also will the rich man fade away in the midst of his pursuits.
verses.textEnNkjv: For no sooner has the sun risen with a burning heat than it withers the grass; its flower falls, and its beautiful appearance perishes. So the rich man also will fade away in his pursuits.
verses.textEnNlt: The hot sun rises and the grass withers; the little flower droops and falls, and its beauty fades away. In the same way, the rich will fade away with all of their achievements.
verses.textEnNasb: For the sun rises with its scorching heat and withers the grass; and its flower falls off and the beauty of its appearance is destroyed; so also the rich person, in the midst of his pursuits, will die out.
verses.textEn: For the sun rises with scorching heat and withers the plant; its blossom falls and its beauty is destroyed. In the same way, the rich will fade away even while they go about their business.

verses.textZh: 能忍受试炼的人，是有福的；因为他经过考验之后，必得着生命的冠冕，这冠冕是主应许给爱他的人的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 能忍受试炼的人，是有福的；因为他经过考验之后，必得着生命的冠冕，这冠冕是主应许给爱他的人的。
verses.textZhCuv: 忍受试探的人是有福的，因为他经过试验以后，必得生命的冠冕；这是主应许给那些爱他之人的。
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed is the one who perseveres under trial because, having stood the test, that person will receive the crown of life that the Lord has promised to those who love him.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed is the man who remains steadfast under trial, for when he has stood the test he will receive the crown of life, which God has promised to those who love him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed is the man who endures temptation; for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord has promised to those who love Him.
verses.textEnNlt: God blesses those who patiently endure testing and temptation. Afterward they will receive the crown of life that God has promised to those who love him.
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed is a man who perseveres under trial; for once he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord has promised to those who love Him.
verses.textEn: Blessed is the one who perseveres under trial because, having stood the test, that person will receive the crown of life that the Lord has promised to those who love him.

verses.textZh: 人被试探，不可说"我被神试探"；因为神不能被恶试探，他也不试探任何人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人被试探，不可说"我被神试探"；因为神不能被恶试探，他也不试探任何人。
verses.textZhCuv: 人被试探，不可说：「我是被神试探」；因为神不能被恶试探，他也不试探人。
verses.textEnNiv: When tempted, no one should say, "God is tempting me." For God cannot be tempted by evil, nor does he tempt anyone;
verses.textEnEsv: Let no one say when he is tempted, "I am being tempted by God," for God cannot be tempted with evil, and he himself tempts no one.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let no one say when he is tempted, "I am tempted by God"; for God cannot be tempted by evil, nor does He Himself tempt anyone.
verses.textEnNlt: And remember, when you are being tempted, do not say, "God is tempting me." God is never tempted to do wrong, and he never tempts anyone else.
verses.textEnNasb: No one is to say when he is tempted, "I am being tempted by God"; for God cannot be tempted by evil, and He Himself does not tempt anyone.
verses.textEn: When tempted, no one should say, "God is tempting me." For God cannot be tempted by evil, nor does he tempt anyone;

verses.textZh: 每一个人受试探，都是被自己的私欲所勾引诱惑的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每一个人受试探，都是被自己的私欲所勾引诱惑的。
verses.textZhCuv: 但各人被试探，乃是被自己的私欲牵引诱惑的。
verses.textEnNiv: but each person is tempted when they are dragged away by their own evil desire and enticed.
verses.textEnEsv: But each person is tempted when he is lured and enticed by his own desire.
verses.textEnNkjv: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own desires and enticed.
verses.textEnNlt: Temptation comes from our own desires, which entice us and drag us away.
verses.textEnNasb: But each one is tempted when he is carried away and enticed by his own lust.
verses.textEn: but each person is tempted when they are dragged away by their own evil desire and enticed.

verses.textZh: 私欲怀了胎，就生出罪；罪长成了，就产生死亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 私欲怀了胎，就生出罪；罪长成了，就产生死亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 私欲既怀了胎，就生出罪来；罪既长成，就生出死来。
verses.textEnNiv: Then, after desire has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is full-grown, gives birth to death.
verses.textEnEsv: Then desire when it has conceived gives birth to sin, and sin when it is fully grown brings forth death.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then, when desire has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is full-grown, brings forth death.
verses.textEnNlt: These desires give birth to sinful actions. And when sin is allowed to grow, it gives birth to death.
verses.textEnNasb: Then when lust has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and sin, when it has run its course, brings forth death.
verses.textEn: Then, after desire has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is full-grown, gives birth to death.

verses.textZh: 我亲爱的弟兄们，不要看错了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我亲爱的弟兄们，不要看错了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我亲爱的弟兄们，不要看错了。
verses.textEnNiv: Don’t be deceived, my dear brothers and sisters.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not be deceived, my beloved brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not be deceived, my beloved brethren.
verses.textEnNlt: So don’t be misled, my dear brothers and sisters.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not be deceived, my beloved brothers and sisters.
verses.textEn: Don’t be deceived, my dear brothers and sisters.

verses.textZh: 各样美好的赏赐，各样完备的恩赐，都是从上面、从众光之父降下来的，他本身并没有改变，也没有转动的影子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 各样美好的赏赐，各样完备的恩赐，都是从上面、从众光之父降下来的，他本身并没有改变，也没有转动的影子。
verses.textZhCuv: 各样美善的恩赐和各样全备的赏赐都是从上头来的，从众光之父那里降下来的；在他并没有改变，也没有转动的影儿。
verses.textEnNiv: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, who does not change like shifting shadows.
verses.textEnEsv: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom there is no variation or shadow due to change.
verses.textEnNkjv: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and comes down from the Father of lights, with whom there is no variation or shadow of turning.
verses.textEnNlt: Whatever is good and perfect is a gift coming down to us from God our Father, who created all the lights in the heavens. He never changes or casts a shifting shadow.
verses.textEnNasb: Every good thing given and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom there is no variation or shifting shadow.
verses.textEn: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, who does not change like shifting shadows.

verses.textZh: 他凭着自己的旨意，借着真理的道生了我们，使我们作他所造的万物中初熟的果子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他凭着自己的旨意，借着真理的道生了我们，使我们作他所造的万物中初熟的果子。
verses.textZhCuv: 他按自己的旨意，用真道生了我们，叫我们在他所造的万物中好像初熟的果子。
verses.textEnNiv: He chose to give us birth through the word of truth, that we might be a kind of firstfruits of all he created.
verses.textEnEsv: Of his own will he brought us forth by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of His own will He brought us forth by the word of truth, that we might be a kind of firstfruits of His creatures.
verses.textEnNlt: He chose to give birth to us by giving us his true word. And we, out of all creation, became his prized possession.
verses.textEnNasb: In the exercise of His will He gave us birth by the word of truth, so that we would be a kind of first fruits among His creatures.
verses.textEn: He chose to give us birth through the word of truth, that we might be a kind of firstfruits of all he created.

verses.textZh: 我亲爱的弟兄们，你们要知道，人人都应该快快地听，慢慢地说，慢一点动怒；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我亲爱的弟兄们，你们要知道，人人都应该快快地听，慢慢地说，慢一点动怒；
verses.textZhCuv: 我亲爱的弟兄们，这是你们所知道的。但你们各人要快快地听，慢慢地说，慢慢地动怒，
verses.textEnNiv: My dear brothers and sisters, take note of this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak and slow to become angry,
verses.textEnEsv: Know this, my beloved brothers: let every person be quick to hear, slow to speak, slow to anger;
verses.textEnNkjv: So then, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath;
verses.textEnNlt: Understand this, my dear brothers and sisters: You must all be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to get angry.
verses.textEnNasb: You know this, my beloved brothers and sisters. Now everyone must be quick to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;
verses.textEn: My dear brothers and sisters, take note of this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak and slow to become angry,

verses.textZh: 因为人的忿怒并不能成全神的义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为人的忿怒并不能成全神的义。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为人的怒气并不成就神的义。
verses.textEnNiv: because human anger does not produce the righteousness that God desires.
verses.textEnEsv: for the anger of man does not produce the righteousness of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: for the wrath of man does not produce the righteousness of God.
verses.textEnNlt: Human anger does not produce the righteousness God desires.
verses.textEnNasb: for a man’s anger does not bring about the righteousness of God.
verses.textEn: because human anger does not produce the righteousness that God desires.

verses.textZh: 所以你们应当摆脱一切污秽和所有的邪恶，以温柔的心领受神栽种的道；这道能救你们的灵魂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你们应当摆脱一切污秽和所有的邪恶，以温柔的心领受神栽种的道；这道能救你们的灵魂。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们要脱去一切的污秽和盈余的邪恶，存温柔的心领受那所栽种的道，就是能救你们灵魂的道。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, get rid of all moral filth and the evil that is so prevalent and humbly accept the word planted in you, which can save you.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore put away all filthiness and rampant wickedness and receive with meekness the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore lay aside all filthiness and overflow of wickedness, and receive with meekness the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.
verses.textEnNlt: So get rid of all the filth and evil in your lives, and humbly accept the word God has planted in your hearts, for it has the power to save your souls.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, ridding yourselves of all filthiness and all that remains of wickedness, in humility receive the word implanted, which is able to save your souls.
verses.textEn: Therefore, get rid of all moral filth and the evil that is so prevalent and humbly accept the word planted in you, which can save you.

verses.textZh: 你们应该作行道的人，不要单作听道的人，自己欺骗自己；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们应该作行道的人，不要单作听道的人，自己欺骗自己；
verses.textZhCuv: 只是你们要行道，不要单单听道，自己欺哄自己。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not merely listen to the word, and so deceive yourselves. Do what it says.
verses.textEnEsv: But be doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving yourselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: But be doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving yourselves.
verses.textEnNlt: But don’t just listen to God’s word. You must do what it says. Otherwise, you are only fooling yourselves.
verses.textEnNasb: But prove yourselves doers of the word, and not just hearers who deceive themselves.
verses.textEn: Do not merely listen to the word, and so deceive yourselves. Do what it says.

verses.textZh: 因为人若只作听道的人，不作行道的人，他就像一个人对着镜子看自己本来的面貌，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为人若只作听道的人，不作行道的人，他就像一个人对着镜子看自己本来的面貌，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为听道而不行道的，就像人对着镜子看自己本来的面目，
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who listens to the word but does not do what it says is like someone who looks at his face in a mirror
verses.textEnEsv: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man who looks intently at his natural face in a mirror.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man observing his natural face in a mirror;
verses.textEnNlt: For if you listen to the word and don’t obey, it is like glancing at your face in a mirror.
verses.textEnNasb: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man who looks at his natural face in a mirror;
verses.textEn: Anyone who listens to the word but does not do what it says is like someone who looks at his face in a mirror

verses.textZh: 看过走开以后，马上就忘记自己的样子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看过走开以后，马上就忘记自己的样子。
verses.textZhCuv: 看见，走后，随即忘了他的相貌如何。
verses.textEnNiv: and, after looking at himself, goes away and immediately forgets what he looks like.
verses.textEnEsv: For he looks at himself and goes away and at once forgets what he was like.
verses.textEnNkjv: for he observes himself, goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.
verses.textEnNlt: You see yourself, walk away, and forget what you look like.
verses.textEnNasb: for once he has looked at himself and gone away, he has immediately forgotten what kind of person he was.
verses.textEn: and, after looking at himself, goes away and immediately forgets what he looks like.

verses.textZh: 唯有详细察看那使人自由的全备的律法，并且时常遵守的人，他不是听了就忘记，而是实行出来，就必因自己所作的蒙福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 唯有详细察看那使人自由的全备的律法，并且时常遵守的人，他不是听了就忘记，而是实行出来，就必因自己所作的蒙福。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有详细察看那全备、使人自由之律法的，并且时常如此，这人既不是听了就忘，乃是实在行出来，就在他所行的事上必然得福。
verses.textEnNiv: But whoever looks intently into the perfect law that gives freedom, and continues in it—not forgetting what they have heard, but doing it—they will be blessed in what they do.
verses.textEnEsv: But the one who looks into the perfect law, the law of liberty, and perseveres, being no hearer who forgets but a doer who acts, he will be blessed in his doing.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he who looks into the perfect law of liberty and continues init, and is not a forgetful hearer but a doer of the work, this one will be blessed in what he does.
verses.textEnNlt: But if you look carefully into the perfect law that sets you free, and if you do what it says and don’t forget what you heard, then God will bless you for doing it.
verses.textEnNasb: But one who has looked intently at the perfect law, the law of freedom, and has continued in it, not having become a forgetful hearer but an active doer, this person will be blessed in what he does.
verses.textEn: But whoever looks intently into the perfect law that gives freedom, and continues in it—not forgetting what they have heard, but doing it—they will be blessed in what they do.

verses.textZh: 如果有人自以为虔诚，却不约束他的舌头，反而自己欺骗自己，这人的虔诚是没有用的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人自以为虔诚，却不约束他的舌头，反而自己欺骗自己，这人的虔诚是没有用的。
verses.textZhCuv: 若有人自以为虔诚，却不勒住他的舌头，反欺哄自己的心，这人的虔诚是虚的。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who consider themselves religious and yet do not keep a tight rein on their tongues deceive themselves, and their religion is worthless.
verses.textEnEsv: If anyone thinks he is religious and does not bridle his tongue but deceives his heart, this person’s religion is worthless.
verses.textEnNkjv: If anyone among you thinks he is religious, and does not bridle his tongue but deceives his own heart, this one’s religion is useless.
verses.textEnNlt: If you claim to be religious but don’t control your tongue, you are fooling yourself, and your religion is worthless.
verses.textEnNasb: If anyone thinks himself to be religious, yet does not bridle his tongue but deceives his own heart, this person’s religion is worthless.
verses.textEn: Those who consider themselves religious and yet do not keep a tight rein on their tongues deceive themselves, and their religion is worthless.

verses.textZh: 在父神看来，纯洁无玷污的虔诚，就是照顾患难中的孤儿寡妇，并且保守自己不被世俗所污染。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在父神看来，纯洁无玷污的虔诚，就是照顾患难中的孤儿寡妇，并且保守自己不被世俗所污染。
verses.textZhCuv: 在神我们的父面前，那清洁没有玷污的虔诚，就是看顾在患难中的孤儿寡妇，并且保守自己不沾染世俗。
verses.textEnNiv: Religion that God our Father accepts as pure and faultless is this: to look after orphans and widows in their distress and to keep oneself from being polluted by the world.
verses.textEnEsv: Religion that is pure and undefiled before God the Father is this: to visit orphans and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained from the world.
verses.textEnNkjv: Pure and undefiled religion before God and the Father is this: to visit orphans and widows in their trouble, and to keep oneself unspotted from the world.
verses.textEnNlt: Pure and genuine religion in the sight of God the Father means caring for orphans and widows in their distress and refusing to let the world corrupt you.
verses.textEnNasb: Pure and undefiled religion in the sight of our God and Father is this: to visit orphans and widows in their distress, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.
verses.textEn: Religion that God our Father accepts as pure and faultless is this: to look after orphans and widows in their distress and to keep oneself from being polluted by the world.

verses.textZh: 我的弟兄们，你们既然对我们荣耀的主耶稣基督有信心，就不应该凭外貌待人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的弟兄们，你们既然对我们荣耀的主耶稣基督有信心，就不应该凭外貌待人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的弟兄们，你们信奉我们荣耀的主耶稣基督，便不可按着外貌待人。
verses.textEnNiv: My brothers and sisters, believers in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ must not show favoritism.
verses.textEnEsv: My brothers, show no partiality as you hold the faith in our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: My brethren, do not hold the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, theLord of glory, with partiality.
verses.textEnNlt: My dear brothers and sisters, how can you claim to have faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ if you favor some people over others?
verses.textEnNasb: My brothers and sisters, do not hold your faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ with an attitude of personal favoritism.
verses.textEn: My brothers and sisters, believers in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ must not show favoritism.

verses.textZh: 如果有一个手戴金戒指、身穿华丽衣服的人，进入你们的会堂；又有一个衣衫褴褛的穷人，也进去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有一个手戴金戒指、身穿华丽衣服的人，进入你们的会堂；又有一个衣衫褴褛的穷人，也进去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 若有一个人带着金戒指，穿着华美衣服，进你们的会堂去；又有一个穷人穿着肮脏衣服也进去；
verses.textEnNiv: Suppose a man comes into your meeting wearing a gold ring and fine clothes, and a poor man in filthy old clothes also comes in.
verses.textEnEsv: For if a man wearing a gold ring and fine clothing comes into your assembly, and a poor man in shabby clothing also comes in,
verses.textEnNkjv: For if there should come into your assembly a man with gold rings, in fine apparel, and there should also come in a poor man in filthy clothes,
verses.textEnNlt: For example, suppose someone comes into your meeting dressed in fancy clothes and expensive jewelry, and another comes in who is poor and dressed in dirty clothes.
verses.textEnNasb: For if a man comes into your assembly with a gold ring and is dressed in bright clothes, and a poor man in dirty clothes also comes in,
verses.textEn: Suppose a man comes into your meeting wearing a gold ring and fine clothes, and a poor man in filthy old clothes also comes in.

verses.textZh: 你们就看重那穿华丽衣服的人，说："请坐在这好位上。"又对那个穷人说："你站在那里。"或说："坐在我的脚凳下边。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们就看重那穿华丽衣服的人，说："请坐在这好位上。"又对那个穷人说："你站在那里。"或说："坐在我的脚凳下边。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们就重看那穿华美衣服的人，说：「请坐在这好位上」；又对那穷人说：「你站在那里」，或「坐在我脚凳下边。」
verses.textEnNiv: If you show special attention to the man wearing fine clothes and say, "Here’s a good seat for you," but say to the poor man, "You stand there" or "Sit on the floor by my feet,"
verses.textEnEsv: and if you pay attention to the one who wears the fine clothing and say, "You sit here in a good place," while you say to the poor man, "You stand over there," or, "Sit down at my feet,"
verses.textEnNkjv: and you pay attention to the one wearing the fine clothes and say to him, "You sit here in a good place," and say to the poor man, "You stand there," or, "Sit here at my footstool,"
verses.textEnNlt: If you give special attention and a good seat to the rich person, but you say to the poor one, "You can stand over there, or else sit on the floor"—well,
verses.textEnNasb: and you pay special attention to the one who is wearing the bright clothes, and say, "You sit here in a good place," and you say to the poor man, "You stand over there, or sit down by my footstool,"
verses.textEn: If you show special attention to the man wearing fine clothes and say, "Here’s a good seat for you," but say to the poor man, "You stand there" or "Sit on the floor by my feet,"

verses.textZh: 这不是你们对人有歧视，成了心怀恶意的审判官吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 这不是你们对人有歧视，成了心怀恶意的审判官吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 这岂不是你们偏心待人，用恶意断定人吗？
verses.textEnNiv: have you not discriminated among yourselves and become judges with evil thoughts?
verses.textEnEsv: have you not then made distinctions among yourselves and become judges with evil thoughts?
verses.textEnNkjv: have you not shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?
verses.textEnNlt: doesn’t this discrimination show that your judgments are guided by evil motives?
verses.textEnNasb: have you not made distinctions among yourselves, and become judges with evil motives?
verses.textEn: have you not discriminated among yourselves and become judges with evil thoughts?

verses.textZh: 我亲爱的弟兄们，请听：神不是拣选了在世上被认为贫穷的人吗？这些人却在信心上富足，而且是承受神的国的人。这国是神应许赐给爱他的人的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我亲爱的弟兄们，请听：神不是拣选了在世上被认为贫穷的人吗？这些人却在信心上富足，而且是承受神的国的人。这国是神应许赐给爱他的人的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我亲爱的弟兄们，请听，神岂不是拣选了世上的贫穷人，叫他们在信上富足，并承受他所应许给那些爱他之人的国吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Listen, my dear brothers and sisters: Has not God chosen those who are poor in the eyes of the world to be rich in faith and to inherit the kingdom he promised those who love him?
verses.textEnEsv: Listen, my beloved brothers, has not God chosen those who are poor in the world to be rich in faith and heirs of the kingdom, which he has promised to those who love him?
verses.textEnNkjv: Listen, my beloved brethren: Has God not chosen the poor of this world tobe rich in faith and heirs of the kingdom which He promised to those who love Him?
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to me, dear brothers and sisters. Hasn’t God chosen the poor in this world to be rich in faith? Aren’t they the ones who will inherit the Kingdom he promised to those who love him?
verses.textEnNasb: Listen, my beloved brothers and sisters: did God not choose the poor of this world to be rich in faith and heirs of the kingdom which He promised to those who love Him?
verses.textEn: Listen, my dear brothers and sisters: Has not God chosen those who are poor in the eyes of the world to be rich in faith and to inherit the kingdom he promised those who love him?

verses.textZh: 然而你们却侮辱穷人。其实，那些欺压你们，拉你们上法庭的，不就是富足的人吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而你们却侮辱穷人。其实，那些欺压你们，拉你们上法庭的，不就是富足的人吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们反倒羞辱贫穷人。那富足人岂不是欺压你们、拉你们到公堂去吗？
verses.textEnNiv: But you have dishonored the poor. Is it not the rich who are exploiting you? Are they not the ones who are dragging you into court?
verses.textEnEsv: But you have dishonored the poor man. Are not the rich the ones who oppress you, and the ones who drag you into court?
verses.textEnNkjv: But you have dishonored the poor man. Do not the rich oppress you and drag you into the courts?
verses.textEnNlt: But you dishonor the poor! Isn’t it the rich who oppress you and drag you into court?
verses.textEnNasb: But you have dishonored the poor man. Is it not the rich who oppress you and personally drag you into court?
verses.textEn: But you have dishonored the poor. Is it not the rich who are exploiting you? Are they not the ones who are dragging you into court?

verses.textZh: 难道不是他们亵渎那召你们的尊名吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道不是他们亵渎那召你们的尊名吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 他们不是亵渎你们所敬奉 的尊名吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Are they not the ones who are blaspheming the noble name of him to whom you belong?
verses.textEnEsv: Are they not the ones who blaspheme the honorable name by which you were called?
verses.textEnNkjv: Do they not blaspheme that noble name by which you are called?
verses.textEnNlt: Aren’t they the ones who slander Jesus Christ, whose noble name you bear?
verses.textEnNasb: Do they not blaspheme the good name by which you have been called?
verses.textEn: Are they not the ones who are blaspheming the noble name of him to whom you belong?

verses.textZh: 你们若照着圣经所说"要爱人如己"这话，去完成这至尊的律法，你们就作对了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们若照着圣经所说"要爱人如己"这话，去完成这至尊的律法，你们就作对了。
verses.textZhCuv: 经上记着说：「要爱人如己。」你们若全守这至尊的律法才是好的。
verses.textEnNiv: If you really keep the royal law found in Scripture, "Love your neighbor as yourself," you are doing right.
verses.textEnEsv: If you really fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, "You shall love your neighbor as yourself," you are doing well.
verses.textEnNkjv: If you really fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, "You shall love your neighbor as yourself," you do well;
verses.textEnNlt: Yes indeed, it is good when you obey the royal law as found in the Scriptures: "Love your neighbor as yourself."
verses.textEnNasb: If, however, you are fulfilling the royal law according to the Scripture, "You shall love your neighbor as yourself," you are doing well.
verses.textEn: If you really keep the royal law found in Scripture, "Love your neighbor as yourself," you are doing right.

verses.textZh: 如果你们凭外貌待人，就是犯罪，律法就要裁定你们是犯法的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们凭外貌待人，就是犯罪，律法就要裁定你们是犯法的。
verses.textZhCuv: 但你们若按外貌待人，便是犯罪，被律法定为犯法的。
verses.textEnNiv: But if you show favoritism, you sin and are convicted by the law as lawbreakers.
verses.textEnEsv: But if you show partiality, you are committing sin and are convicted by the law as transgressors.
verses.textEnNkjv: but if you show partiality, you commit sin, and are convicted by the law as transgressors.
verses.textEnNlt: But if you favor some people over others, you are committing a sin. You are guilty of breaking the law.
verses.textEnNasb: But if you show partiality, you are committing sin and are convicted by the Law as violators.
verses.textEn: But if you show favoritism, you sin and are convicted by the law as lawbreakers.

verses.textZh: 因为凡是遵守全部律法的，只要在一条上失足，就违犯所有的了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为凡是遵守全部律法的，只要在一条上失足，就违犯所有的了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为凡遵守全律法的，只在一条上跌倒，他就是犯了众条。
verses.textEnNiv: For whoever keeps the whole law and yet stumbles at just one point is guilty of breaking all of it.
verses.textEnEsv: For whoever keeps the whole law but fails in one point has become guilty of all of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: For whoever shall keep the whole law, and yet stumble in one point, he is guilty of all.
verses.textEnNlt: For the person who keeps all of the laws except one is as guilty as a person who has broken all of God’s laws.
verses.textEnNasb: For whoever keeps the whole Law, yet stumbles in one point, has become guilty of all.
verses.textEn: For whoever keeps the whole law and yet stumbles at just one point is guilty of breaking all of it.

verses.textZh: 就像那说"不可奸淫"的，也说"不可杀人"；你纵然不奸淫，却杀人，还是犯法的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就像那说"不可奸淫"的，也说"不可杀人"；你纵然不奸淫，却杀人，还是犯法的。
verses.textZhCuv: 原来那说「不可奸淫」的，也说「不可杀人」；你就是不奸淫，却杀人，仍是成了犯律法的。
verses.textEnNiv: For he who said, "You shall not commit adultery," also said, "You shall not murder." If you do not commit adultery but do commit murder, you have become a lawbreaker.
verses.textEnEsv: For he who said, "Do not commit adultery," also said, "Do not murder." If you do not commit adultery but do murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He who said, "Do not commit adultery," also said, "Do not murder." Now if you do not commit adultery, but you do murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.
verses.textEnNlt: For the same God who said, "You must not commit adultery," also said, "You must not murder." So if you murder someone but do not commit adultery, you have still broken the law.
verses.textEnNasb: For He who said, "Do not commit adultery," also said, "Do not murder." Now if you do not commit adultery, but do murder, you have become a violator of the Law.
verses.textEn: For he who said, "You shall not commit adultery," also said, "You shall not murder." If you do not commit adultery but do commit murder, you have become a lawbreaker.

verses.textZh: 你们既然按着使人自由的律法受审判，就应照着这律法说话行事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们既然按着使人自由的律法受审判，就应照着这律法说话行事。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们既然要按使人自由的律法受审判，就该照这律法说话行事。
verses.textEnNiv: Speak and act as those who are going to be judged by the law that gives freedom,
verses.textEnEsv: So speak and so act as those who are to be judged under the law of liberty.
verses.textEnNkjv: So speak and so do as those who will be judged by the law of liberty.
verses.textEnNlt: So whatever you say or whatever you do, remember that you will be judged by the law that sets you free.
verses.textEnNasb: So speak, and so act, as those who are to be judged by the law of freedom.
verses.textEn: Speak and act as those who are going to be judged by the law that gives freedom,

verses.textZh: 因为对不行怜悯的人，审判他们的时候就没有怜悯；怜悯胜过审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为对不行怜悯的人，审判他们的时候就没有怜悯；怜悯胜过审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为那不怜悯人的，也要受无怜悯的审判；怜悯原是向审判夸胜。
verses.textEnNiv: because judgment without mercy will be shown to anyone who has not been merciful. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
verses.textEnEsv: For judgment is without mercy to one who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
verses.textEnNkjv: For judgment is without mercy to the one who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
verses.textEnNlt: There will be no mercy for those who have not shown mercy to others. But if you have been merciful, God will be merciful when he judges you.
verses.textEnNasb: For judgment will be merciless to one who has shown no mercy; mercy triumphs over judgment.
verses.textEn: because judgment without mercy will be shown to anyone who has not been merciful. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

verses.textZh: 我的弟兄们，人若说他有信心，却没有行为，有甚么益处呢？这信心能救他吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的弟兄们，人若说他有信心，却没有行为，有甚么益处呢？这信心能救他吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我的弟兄们，若有人说自己有信心，却没有行为，有什么益处呢？这信心能救他吗？
verses.textEnNiv: What good is it, my brothers and sisters, if someone claims to have faith but has no deeds? Can such faith save them?
verses.textEnEsv: What good is it, my brothers, if someone says he has faith but does not have works? Can that faith save him?
verses.textEnNkjv: What doesit profit, my brethren, if someone says he has faith but does not have works? Can faith save him?
verses.textEnNlt: What good is it, dear brothers and sisters, if you say you have faith but don’t show it by your actions? Can that kind of faith save anyone?
verses.textEnNasb: What use is it, my brothers and sisters, if someone says he has faith, but he has no works? Can that faith save him?
verses.textEn: What good is it, my brothers and sisters, if someone claims to have faith but has no deeds? Can such faith save them?

verses.textZh: 如果有弟兄或姊妹缺衣少食，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有弟兄或姊妹缺衣少食，
verses.textZhCuv: 若是弟兄或是姊妹，赤身露体，又缺了日用的饮食；
verses.textEnNiv: Suppose a brother or a sister is without clothes and daily food.
verses.textEnEsv: If a brother or sister is poorly clothed and lacking in daily food,
verses.textEnNkjv: If a brother or sister is naked and destitute of daily food,
verses.textEnNlt: Suppose you see a brother or sister who has no food or clothing,
verses.textEnNasb: If a brother or sister is without clothing and in need of daily food,
verses.textEn: Suppose a brother or a sister is without clothes and daily food.

verses.textZh: 而你们中间有人对他们说："平平安安地去吧！愿你们穿得暖，吃得饱。"却不给他们身体所需用的，那有甚么用处呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 而你们中间有人对他们说："平平安安地去吧！愿你们穿得暖，吃得饱。"却不给他们身体所需用的，那有甚么用处呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们中间有人对他们说：「平平安安地去吧！愿你们穿得暖，吃得饱」，却不给他们身体所需用的，这有什么益处呢？
verses.textEnNiv: If one of you says to them, "Go in peace; keep warm and well fed," but does nothing about their physical needs, what good is it?
verses.textEnEsv: and one of you says to them, "Go in peace, be warmed and filled," without giving them the things needed for the body, what good is that?
verses.textEnNkjv: and one of you says to them, "Depart in peace, be warmed and filled," but you do not give them the things which are needed for the body, what doesit profit?
verses.textEnNlt: and you say, "Good-bye and have a good day; stay warm and eat well"—but then you don’t give that person any food or clothing. What good does that do?
verses.textEnNasb: and one of you says to them, "Go in peace, be warmed and be filled," yet you do not give them what is necessary for their body, what use is that?
verses.textEn: If one of you says to them, "Go in peace; keep warm and well fed," but does nothing about their physical needs, what good is it?

verses.textZh: 照样，如果只有信心，没有行为，这信心就是死的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 照样，如果只有信心，没有行为，这信心就是死的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，信心若没有行为就是死的。
verses.textEnNiv: In the same way, faith by itself, if it is not accompanied by action, is dead.
verses.textEnEsv: So also faith by itself, if it does not have works, is dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus also faith by itself, if it does not have works, is dead.
verses.textEnNlt: So you see, faith by itself isn’t enough. Unless it produces good deeds, it is dead and useless.
verses.textEnNasb: In the same way, faith also, if it has no works, is dead, being by itself.
verses.textEn: In the same way, faith by itself, if it is not accompanied by action, is dead.

verses.textZh: 也许有人要说，你有信心，我有行为；请把你没有行为的信心指给我看，我就借着我的行为，把我的信心指给你看。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也许有人要说，你有信心，我有行为；请把你没有行为的信心指给我看，我就借着我的行为，把我的信心指给你看。
verses.textZhCuv: 必有人说：「你有信心，我有行为；你将你没有行为的信心指给我看，我便藉着我的行为，将我的信心指给你看。」
verses.textEnNiv: But someone will say, "You have faith; I have deeds." Show me your faith without deeds, and I will show you my faith by my deeds.
verses.textEnEsv: But someone will say, "You have faith and I have works." Show me your faith apart from your works, and I will show you my faith by my works.
verses.textEnNkjv: But someone will say, "You have faith, and I have works." Show me your faith without your works, and I will show you my faith by my works.
verses.textEnNlt: Now someone may argue, "Some people have faith; others have good deeds." But I say, "How can you show me your faith if you don’t have good deeds? I will show you my faith by my good deeds."
verses.textEnNasb: But someone may well say, "You have faith and I have works; show me your faith without the works, and I will show you my faith by my works."
verses.textEn: But someone will say, "You have faith; I have deeds." Show me your faith without deeds, and I will show you my faith by my deeds.

verses.textZh: 你信神只有一位，你信的不错；就连鬼魔也信，却是战兢。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你信神只有一位，你信的不错；就连鬼魔也信，却是战兢。
verses.textZhCuv: 你信神只有一位，你信的不错；鬼魔也信，却是战惊。
verses.textEnNiv: You believe that there is one God. Good! Even the demons believe that—and shudder.
verses.textEnEsv: You believe that God is one; you do well. Even the demons believe—and shudder!
verses.textEnNkjv: You believe that there is one God. You do well. Even the demons believe—and tremble!
verses.textEnNlt: You say you have faith, for you believe that there is one God. Good for you! Even the demons believe this, and they tremble in terror.
verses.textEnNasb: You believe that God is one. You do well; the demons also believe, and shudder.
verses.textEn: You believe that there is one God. Good! Even the demons believe that—and shudder.

verses.textZh: 愚昧的人哪，你愿意知道没有行为的信心是没有用的吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚昧的人哪，你愿意知道没有行为的信心是没有用的吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 虚浮的人哪，你愿意知道没有行为的信心是死的吗？
verses.textEnNiv: You foolish person, do you want evidence that faith without deeds is useless ?
verses.textEnEsv: Do you want to be shown, you foolish person, that faith apart from works is useless?
verses.textEnNkjv: But do you want to know, O foolish man, that faith without works is dead?
verses.textEnNlt: How foolish! Can’t you see that faith without good deeds is useless?
verses.textEnNasb: But are you willing to acknowledge, you foolish person, that faith without works is useless?
verses.textEn: You foolish person, do you want evidence that faith without deeds is useless ?

verses.textZh: 我们的祖先亚伯拉罕，把他的儿子以撒献在祭坛上，不是因行为称义吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的祖先亚伯拉罕，把他的儿子以撒献在祭坛上，不是因行为称义吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的祖宗亚伯拉罕把他儿子以撒献在坛上，岂不是因行为称义吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Was not our father Abraham considered righteous for what he did when he offered his son Isaac on the altar?
verses.textEnEsv: Was not Abraham our father justified by works when he offered up his son Isaac on the altar?
verses.textEnNkjv: Was not Abraham our father justified by works when he offered Isaac his son on the altar?
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t you remember that our ancestor Abraham was shown to be right with God by his actions when he offered his son Isaac on the altar?
verses.textEnNasb: Was our father Abraham not justified by works when he offered up his son Isaac on the altar?
verses.textEn: Was not our father Abraham considered righteous for what he did when he offered his son Isaac on the altar?

verses.textZh: 你看，他的信心与行为是一致的，信心就因着行为得到完全了；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你看，他的信心与行为是一致的，信心就因着行为得到完全了；
verses.textZhCuv: 可见，信心是与他的行为并行，而且信心因着行为才得成全。
verses.textEnNiv: You see that his faith and his actions were working together, and his faith was made complete by what he did.
verses.textEnEsv: You see that faith was active along with his works, and faith was completed by his works;
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you see that faith was working together with his works, and by works faith was made perfect?
verses.textEnNlt: You see, his faith and his actions worked together. His actions made his faith complete.
verses.textEnNasb: You see that faith was working with his works, and as a result of the works, faith was perfected;
verses.textEn: You see that his faith and his actions were working together, and his faith was made complete by what he did.

verses.textZh: 这正应验了经上所说的："亚伯拉罕信神，这就算为他的义。"他也被称为神的朋友。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这正应验了经上所说的："亚伯拉罕信神，这就算为他的义。"他也被称为神的朋友。
verses.textZhCuv: 这就应验经上所说：「亚伯拉罕信神，这就算为他的义。」他又得称为神的朋友。
verses.textEnNiv: And the scripture was fulfilled that says, "Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness," and he was called God’s friend.
verses.textEnEsv: and the Scripture was fulfilled that says, "Abraham believed God, and it was counted to him as righteousness"—and he was called a friend of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Scripture was fulfilled which says, "Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness." And he was called the friend of God.
verses.textEnNlt: And so it happened just as the Scriptures say: "Abraham believed God, and God counted him as righteous because of his faith." He was even called the friend of God.
verses.textEnNasb: and the Scripture was fulfilled which says, "And Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness," and he was called a friend of God.
verses.textEn: And the scripture was fulfilled that says, "Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness," and he was called God’s friend.

verses.textZh: 可见人称义是因着行为，不仅是因着信心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可见人称义是因着行为，不仅是因着信心。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样看来，人称义是因着行为，不是单因着信。
verses.textEnNiv: You see that a person is considered righteous by what they do and not by faith alone.
verses.textEnEsv: You see that a person is justified by works and not by faith alone.
verses.textEnNkjv: You see then that a man is justified by works, and not by faith only.
verses.textEnNlt: So you see, we are shown to be right with God by what we do, not by faith alone.
verses.textEnNasb: You see that a person is justified by works and not by faith alone.
verses.textEn: You see that a person is considered righteous by what they do and not by faith alone.

verses.textZh: 照样，妓女喇合接待了探子，又从另一条路把他们送走，不也是因行为称义吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 照样，妓女喇合接待了探子，又从另一条路把他们送走，不也是因行为称义吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 妓女喇合接待使者，又放他们从别的路上出去，不也是一样因行为称义吗？
verses.textEnNiv: In the same way, was not even Rahab the prostitute considered righteous for what she did when she gave lodging to the spies and sent them off in a different direction?
verses.textEnEsv: And in the same way was not also Rahab the prostitute justified by works when she received the messengers and sent them out by another way?
verses.textEnNkjv: Likewise, was not Rahab the harlot also justified by works when she received the messengers and sent them out another way?
verses.textEnNlt: Rahab the prostitute is another example. She was shown to be right with God by her actions when she hid those messengers and sent them safely away by a different road.
verses.textEnNasb: In the same way, was Rahab the prostitute not justified by works also when she received the messengers and sent them out by another way?
verses.textEn: In the same way, was not even Rahab the prostitute considered righteous for what she did when she gave lodging to the spies and sent them off in a different direction?

verses.textZh: 身体没有灵魂是死的，照样，信心没有行为也是死的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 身体没有灵魂是死的，照样，信心没有行为也是死的。
verses.textZhCuv: 身体没有灵魂是死的，信心没有行为也是死的。
verses.textEnNiv: As the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without deeds is dead.
verses.textEnEsv: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, so also faith apart from works is dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.
verses.textEnNlt: Just as the body is dead without breath, so also faith is dead without good works.
verses.textEnNasb: For just as the body without the spirit is dead, so also faith without works is dead.
verses.textEn: As the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without deeds is dead.

verses.textZh: 我的弟兄们，你们不应该有太多人作教师，因为知道我们作教师的将受更严厉的审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的弟兄们，你们不应该有太多人作教师，因为知道我们作教师的将受更严厉的审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的弟兄们，不要多人作师傅，因为晓得我们要受更重的判断。
verses.textEnNiv: Not many of you should become teachers, my fellow believers, because you know that we who teach will be judged more strictly.
verses.textEnEsv: Not many of you should become teachers, my brothers, for you know that we who teach will be judged with greater strictness.
verses.textEnNkjv: My brethren, let not many of you become teachers, knowing that we shall receive a stricter judgment.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear brothers and sisters, not many of you should become teachers in the church, for we who teach will be judged more strictly.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not become teachers in large numbers, my brothers, since you know that we who are teachers will incur a stricter judgment.
verses.textEn: Not many of you should become teachers, my fellow believers, because you know that we who teach will be judged more strictly.

verses.textZh: 我们在许多的事上都有过错，假如有人在言语上没有过错，他就是完全的人，也能够控制全身。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们在许多的事上都有过错，假如有人在言语上没有过错，他就是完全的人，也能够控制全身。
verses.textZhCuv: 原来我们在许多事上都有过失；若有人在话语上没有过失，他就是完全人，也能勒住自己的全身。
verses.textEnNiv: We all stumble in many ways. Anyone who is never at fault in what they say is perfect, able to keep their whole body in check.
verses.textEnEsv: For we all stumble in many ways. And if anyone does not stumble in what he says, he is a perfect man, able also to bridle his whole body.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we all stumble in many things. If anyone does not stumble in word, he is a perfect man, able also to bridle the whole body.
verses.textEnNlt: Indeed, we all make many mistakes. For if we could control our tongues, we would be perfect and could also control ourselves in every other way.
verses.textEnNasb: For we all stumble in many ways. If anyone does not stumble in what he says, he is a perfect man, able to rein in the whole body as well.
verses.textEn: We all stumble in many ways. Anyone who is never at fault in what they say is perfect, able to keep their whole body in check.

verses.textZh: 我们若把嚼环扣入马嘴，使牠们驯服，就能驾驭牠们的全身。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们若把嚼环扣入马嘴，使牠们驯服，就能驾驭牠们的全身。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们若把嚼环放在马嘴里，叫它顺服，就能调动它的全身。
verses.textEnNiv: When we put bits into the mouths of horses to make them obey us, we can turn the whole animal.
verses.textEnEsv: If we put bits into the mouths of horses so that they obey us, we guide their whole bodies as well.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed, we put bits in horses’ mouths that they may obey us, and we turn their whole body.
verses.textEnNlt: We can make a large horse go wherever we want by means of a small bit in its mouth.
verses.textEnNasb: Now if we put the bits into the horses’ mouths so that they will obey us, we direct their whole body as well.
verses.textEn: When we put bits into the mouths of horses to make them obey us, we can turn the whole animal.

verses.textZh: 试看，船只虽然甚大，又被狂风催逼，舵手只用小小的舵，就可以随意操纵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 试看，船只虽然甚大，又被狂风催逼，舵手只用小小的舵，就可以随意操纵。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，船只虽然甚大，又被大风催逼，只用小小的舵，就随着掌舵的意思转动。
verses.textEnNiv: Or take ships as an example. Although they are so large and are driven by strong winds, they are steered by a very small rudder wherever the pilot wants to go.
verses.textEnEsv: Look at the ships also: though they are so large and are driven by strong winds, they are guided by a very small rudder wherever the will of the pilot directs.
verses.textEnNkjv: Look also at ships: although they are so large and are driven by fierce winds, they are turned by a very small rudder wherever the pilot desires.
verses.textEnNlt: And a small rudder makes a huge ship turn wherever the pilot chooses to go, even though the winds are strong.
verses.textEnNasb: Look at the ships too: though they are so large and are driven by strong winds, they are nevertheless directed by a very small rudder wherever the inclination of the pilot determines.
verses.textEn: Or take ships as an example. Although they are so large and are driven by strong winds, they are steered by a very small rudder wherever the pilot wants to go.

verses.textZh: 照样，舌头虽然是个小肢体，却会说夸大的话。 试看，星星之火，可以燎原；
verses.textZhCnvs: 照样，舌头虽然是个小肢体，却会说夸大的话。 试看，星星之火，可以燎原；
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，舌头在百体里也是最小的，却能说大话。 看哪，最小的火能点着最大的树林。
verses.textEnNiv: Likewise, the tongue is a small part of the body, but it makes great boasts. Consider what a great forest is set on fire by a small spark.
verses.textEnEsv: So also the tongue is a small member, yet it boasts of great things. How great a forest is set ablaze by such a small fire!
verses.textEnNkjv: Even so the tongue is a little member and boasts great things. See how great a forest a little fire kindles!
verses.textEnNlt: In the same way, the tongue is a small thing that makes grand speeches. But a tiny spark can set a great forest on fire.
verses.textEnNasb: So also the tongue is a small part of the body, and yet it boasts of great things. See how great a forest is set aflame by such a small fire!
verses.textEn: Likewise, the tongue is a small part of the body, but it makes great boasts. Consider what a great forest is set on fire by a small spark.

verses.textZh: 舌头就是火，在我们百体中，是个不义的世界，能污秽全身，把整个生命在运转中焚烧起来，而且是被地狱之火点燃的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 舌头就是火，在我们百体中，是个不义的世界，能污秽全身，把整个生命在运转中焚烧起来，而且是被地狱之火点燃的。
verses.textZhCuv: 舌头就是火，在我们百体中，舌头是个罪恶的世界，能污秽全身，也能把生命的轮子点起来，并且是从地狱里点着的。
verses.textEnNiv: The tongue also is a fire, a world of evil among the parts of the body. It corrupts the whole body, sets the whole course of one’s life on fire, and is itself set on fire by hell.
verses.textEnEsv: And the tongue is a fire, a world of unrighteousness. The tongue is set among our members, staining the whole body, setting on fire the entire course of life, and set on fire by hell.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity. The tongue is so set among our members that it defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire by hell.
verses.textEnNlt: And among all the parts of the body, the tongue is a flame of fire. It is a whole world of wickedness, corrupting your entire body. It can set your whole life on fire, for it is set on fire by hell itself.
verses.textEnNasb: And the tongue is a fire, the very world of unrighteousness; the tongue is set among our body’s parts as that which defiles the whole body and sets on fire the course of our life, and is set on fire by hell.
verses.textEn: The tongue also is a fire, a world of evil among the parts of the body. It corrupts the whole body, sets the whole course of one’s life on fire, and is itself set on fire by hell.

verses.textZh: 各类飞禽、走兽、昆虫、水族，都可以驯服，而且都已经被人类制伏了；
verses.textZhCnvs: 各类飞禽、走兽、昆虫、水族，都可以驯服，而且都已经被人类制伏了；
verses.textZhCuv: 各类的走兽、飞禽、昆虫、水族，本来都可以制伏，也已经被人制伏了；
verses.textEnNiv: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles and sea creatures are being tamed and have been tamed by mankind,
verses.textEnEsv: For every kind of beast and bird, of reptile and sea creature, can be tamed and has been tamed by mankind,
verses.textEnNkjv: For every kind of beast and bird, of reptile and creature of the sea, is tamed and has been tamed by mankind.
verses.textEnNlt: People can tame all kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and fish,
verses.textEnNasb: For every species of beasts and birds, of reptiles and creatures of the sea, is tamed and has been tamed by the human race.
verses.textEn: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles and sea creatures are being tamed and have been tamed by mankind,

verses.textZh: 可是没有人能够制伏舌头；它是喋喋不休的恶物，充满了致命的毒素。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是没有人能够制伏舌头；它是喋喋不休的恶物，充满了致命的毒素。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟独舌头没有人能制伏，是不止息的恶物，满了害死人的毒气。
verses.textEnNiv: but no human being can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.
verses.textEnEsv: but no human being can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.
verses.textEnNkjv: But no man can tame the tongue. Itis an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.
verses.textEnNlt: but no one can tame the tongue. It is restless and evil, full of deadly poison.
verses.textEnNasb: But no one among mankind can tame the tongue; it is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.
verses.textEn: but no human being can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

verses.textZh: 我们用它来称颂我们的主和天父，又用它来咒诅照神的形象被造的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们用它来称颂我们的主和天父，又用它来咒诅照神的形象被造的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们用舌头颂赞那为主、为父的，又用舌头咒诅那照着神形象被造的人。
verses.textEnNiv: With the tongue we praise our Lord and Father, and with it we curse human beings, who have been made in God’s likeness.
verses.textEnEsv: With it we bless our Lord and Father, and with it we curse people who are made in the likeness of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men, who have been made in the similitude of God.
verses.textEnNlt: Sometimes it praises our Lord and Father, and sometimes it curses those who have been made in the image of God.
verses.textEnNasb: With it we bless our Lord and Father, and with it we curse people, who have been made in the likeness of God;
verses.textEn: With the tongue we praise our Lord and Father, and with it we curse human beings, who have been made in God’s likeness.

verses.textZh: 同一张嘴竟然又称颂主，又咒诅人；我的弟兄们，这是不应该的！
verses.textZhCnvs: 同一张嘴竟然又称颂主，又咒诅人；我的弟兄们，这是不应该的！
verses.textZhCuv: 颂赞和咒诅从一个口里出来！我的弟兄们，这是不应当的！
verses.textEnNiv: Out of the same mouth come praise and cursing. My brothers and sisters, this should not be.
verses.textEnEsv: From the same mouth come blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.
verses.textEnNkjv: Out of the same mouth proceed blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not to be so.
verses.textEnNlt: And so blessing and cursing come pouring out of the same mouth. Surely, my brothers and sisters, this is not right!
verses.textEnNasb: from the same mouth come both blessing and cursing. My brothers and sisters, these things should not be this way.
verses.textEn: Out of the same mouth come praise and cursing. My brothers and sisters, this should not be.

verses.textZh: 同一泉眼里能够涌出甜水和苦水来吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 同一泉眼里能够涌出甜水和苦水来吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 泉源从一个眼里能发出甜苦两样的水吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Can both fresh water and salt water flow from the same spring?
verses.textEnEsv: Does a spring pour forth from the same opening both fresh and salt water?
verses.textEnNkjv: Does a spring send forth fresh water and bitter from the same opening?
verses.textEnNlt: Does a spring of water bubble out with both fresh water and bitter water?
verses.textEnNasb: Does a spring send out from the same opening both fresh and bitter water?
verses.textEn: Can both fresh water and salt water flow from the same spring?

verses.textZh: 我的弟兄们，无花果树能结橄榄吗？葡萄树能长无花果吗？咸水也不能发出甜水来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的弟兄们，无花果树能结橄榄吗？葡萄树能长无花果吗？咸水也不能发出甜水来。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的弟兄们，无花果树能生橄榄吗？葡萄树能结无花果吗？咸水里也不能发出甜水来。
verses.textEnNiv: My brothers and sisters, can a fig tree bear olives, or a grapevine bear figs? Neither can a salt spring produce fresh water.
verses.textEnEsv: Can a fig tree, my brothers, bear olives, or a grapevine produce figs? Neither can a salt pond yield fresh water.
verses.textEnNkjv: Can a fig tree, my brethren, bear olives, or a grapevine bear figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh.
verses.textEnNlt: Does a fig tree produce olives, or a grapevine produce figs? No, and you can’t draw fresh water from a salty spring.
verses.textEnNasb: Can a fig tree, my brothers and sisters, bear olives, or a vine bear figs? Nor can salt water produce fresh.
verses.textEn: My brothers and sisters, can a fig tree bear olives, or a grapevine bear figs? Neither can a salt spring produce fresh water.

verses.textZh: 你们中间谁是有智慧、有见识的呢？他就应当有美好的生活，用明智的温柔，把自己的行为表现出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们中间谁是有智慧、有见识的呢？他就应当有美好的生活，用明智的温柔，把自己的行为表现出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们中间谁是有智慧有见识的呢？他就当在智慧的温柔上显出他的善行来。
verses.textEnNiv: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let them show it by their good life, by deeds done in the humility that comes from wisdom.
verses.textEnEsv: Who is wise and understanding among you? By his good conduct let him show his works in the meekness of wisdom.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by good conduct that his works aredone in the meekness of wisdom.
verses.textEnNlt: If you are wise and understand God’s ways, prove it by living an honorable life, doing good works with the humility that comes from wisdom.
verses.textEnNasb: Who among you is wise and understanding? Let him show by his good behavior his deeds in the gentleness of wisdom.
verses.textEn: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let them show it by their good life, by deeds done in the humility that comes from wisdom.

verses.textZh: 如果你们心中存着刻薄的嫉妒和自私，就不可夸口，也不可说谎抵挡真理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们心中存着刻薄的嫉妒和自私，就不可夸口，也不可说谎抵挡真理。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们心里若怀着苦毒的嫉妒和纷争，就不可自夸，也不可说谎话抵挡真道。
verses.textEnNiv: But if you harbor bitter envy and selfish ambition in your hearts, do not boast about it or deny the truth.
verses.textEnEsv: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your hearts, do not boast and be false to the truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if you have bitter envy and self-seeking in your hearts, do not boast and lie against the truth.
verses.textEnNlt: But if you are bitterly jealous and there is selfish ambition in your heart, don’t cover up the truth with boasting and lying.
verses.textEnNasb: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, do not be arrogant and so lie against the truth.
verses.textEn: But if you harbor bitter envy and selfish ambition in your hearts, do not boast about it or deny the truth.

verses.textZh: 这种智慧不是从天上来的，而是属地的、属血气的和属鬼魔的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这种智慧不是从天上来的，而是属地的、属血气的和属鬼魔的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样的智慧不是从上头来的，乃是属地的，属情欲的，属鬼魔的。
verses.textEnNiv: Such "wisdom" does not come down from heaven but is earthly, unspiritual, demonic.
verses.textEnEsv: This is not the wisdom that comes down from above, but is earthly, unspiritual, demonic.
verses.textEnNkjv: This wisdom does not descend from above, but is earthly, sensual, demonic.
verses.textEnNlt: For jealousy and selfishness are not God’s kind of wisdom. Such things are earthly, unspiritual, and demonic.
verses.textEnNasb: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, natural, demonic.
verses.textEn: Such "wisdom" does not come down from heaven but is earthly, unspiritual, demonic.

verses.textZh: 因为凡有嫉妒和自私的地方，就必有扰乱和各样的坏事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为凡有嫉妒和自私的地方，就必有扰乱和各样的坏事。
verses.textZhCuv: 在何处有嫉妒、纷争，就在何处有扰乱和各样的坏事。
verses.textEnNiv: For where you have envy and selfish ambition, there you find disorder and every evil practice.
verses.textEnEsv: For where jealousy and selfish ambition exist, there will be disorder and every vile practice.
verses.textEnNkjv: For where envy and self-seeking exist, confusion and every evil thing are there.
verses.textEnNlt: For wherever there is jealousy and selfish ambition, there you will find disorder and evil of every kind.
verses.textEnNasb: For where jealousy and selfish ambition exist, there is disorder and every evil thing.
verses.textEn: For where you have envy and selfish ambition, there you find disorder and every evil practice.

verses.textZh: 至于从天上来的智慧，首先是纯洁的，其次是和平的，温柔的，谦逊的，满有恩慈和善果，没有偏袒，没有虚伪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于从天上来的智慧，首先是纯洁的，其次是和平的，温柔的，谦逊的，满有恩慈和善果，没有偏袒，没有虚伪。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟独从上头来的智慧，先是清洁，后是和平，温良柔顺，满有怜悯，多结善果，没有偏见，没有假冒。
verses.textEnNiv: But the wisdom that comes from heaven is first of all pure; then peace-loving, considerate, submissive, full of mercy and good fruit, impartial and sincere.
verses.textEnEsv: But the wisdom from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, open to reason, full of mercy and good fruits, impartial and sincere.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, willing to yield, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality and without hypocrisy.
verses.textEnNlt: But the wisdom from above is first of all pure. It is also peace loving, gentle at all times, and willing to yield to others. It is full of mercy and the fruit of good deeds. It shows no favoritism and is always sincere.
verses.textEnNasb: But the wisdom from above is first pure, then peace-loving, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, impartial, free of hypocrisy.
verses.textEn: But the wisdom that comes from heaven is first of all pure; then peace-loving, considerate, submissive, full of mercy and good fruit, impartial and sincere.

verses.textZh: 这是缔造和平的人，用和平所培植出来的义果。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是缔造和平的人，用和平所培植出来的义果。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且使人和平的，是用和平所栽种的义果。
verses.textEnNiv: Peacemakers who sow in peace reap a harvest of righteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: And a harvest of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
verses.textEnNlt: And those who are peacemakers will plant seeds of peace and reap a harvest of righteousness.
verses.textEnNasb: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
verses.textEn: Peacemakers who sow in peace reap a harvest of righteousness.

verses.textZh: 你们中间的争执和打斗是从哪里来的呢？不是从你们肢体中好斗的私欲来的吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们中间的争执和打斗是从哪里来的呢？不是从你们肢体中好斗的私欲来的吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们中间的争战斗殴是从哪里来的呢？不是从你们百体中战斗之私欲来的吗？
verses.textEnNiv: What causes fights and quarrels among you? Don’t they come from your desires that battle within you?
verses.textEnEsv: What causes quarrels and what causes fights among you? Is it not this, that your passions are at war within you?
verses.textEnNkjv: Where do wars and fights come from among you? Do they not come from your desiresfor pleasure that war in your members?
verses.textEnNlt: What is causing the quarrels and fights among you? Don’t they come from the evil desires at war within you?
verses.textEnNasb: What is the source of quarrels and conflicts among you? Is the source not your pleasures that wage war in your body’s parts?
verses.textEn: What causes fights and quarrels among you? Don’t they come from your desires that battle within you?

verses.textZh: 你们放纵贪欲，如果得不到，就杀人；你们嫉妒，如果一无所得，就打斗争执。你们得不到，因为你们不求；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们放纵贪欲，如果得不到，就杀人；你们嫉妒，如果一无所得，就打斗争执。你们得不到，因为你们不求；
verses.textZhCuv: 你们贪恋，还是得不着；你们杀害嫉妒，又斗殴争战，也不能得。你们得不着，是因为你们不求。
verses.textEnNiv: You desire but do not have, so you kill. You covet but you cannot get what you want, so you quarrel and fight. You do not have because you do not ask God.
verses.textEnEsv: You desire and do not have, so you murder. You covet and cannot obtain, so you fight and quarrel. You do not have, because you do not ask.
verses.textEnNkjv: You lust and do not have. You murder and covet and cannot obtain. You fight and war. Yet you do not have because you do not ask.
verses.textEnNlt: You want what you don’t have, so you scheme and kill to get it. You are jealous of what others have, but you can’t get it, so you fight and wage war to take it away from them. Yet you don’t have what you want because you don’t ask God for it.
verses.textEnNasb: You lust and do not have, so you commit murder. And you are envious and cannot obtain, so you fight and quarrel. You do not have because you do not ask.
verses.textEn: You desire but do not have, so you kill. You covet but you cannot get what you want, so you quarrel and fight. You do not have because you do not ask God.

verses.textZh: 你们求也得不到，因为你们的动机不良，要把所得的耗费在你们的私欲上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们求也得不到，因为你们的动机不良，要把所得的耗费在你们的私欲上。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们求也得不着，是因为你们妄求，要浪费在你们的宴乐中。
verses.textEnNiv: When you ask, you do not receive, because you ask with wrong motives, that you may spend what you get on your pleasures.
verses.textEnEsv: You ask and do not receive, because you ask wrongly, to spend it on your passions.
verses.textEnNkjv: You ask and do not receive, because you ask amiss, that you may spend it on your pleasures.
verses.textEnNlt: And even when you ask, you don’t get it because your motives are all wrong—you want only what will give you pleasure.
verses.textEnNasb: You ask and do not receive, because you ask with the wrong motives, so that you may spend what you request on your pleasures.
verses.textEn: When you ask, you do not receive, because you ask with wrong motives, that you may spend what you get on your pleasures.

verses.textZh: 淫乱的人哪，你们不知道与世俗为友，就是与神为敌吗？所以与世俗为友的，就成了神的仇敌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 淫乱的人哪，你们不知道与世俗为友，就是与神为敌吗？所以与世俗为友的，就成了神的仇敌。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们这些淫乱的人 哪，岂不知与世俗为友就是与神为敌吗？所以凡想要与世俗为友的，就是与神为敌了。
verses.textEnNiv: You adulterous people, don’t you know that friendship with the world means enmity against God? Therefore, anyone who chooses to be a friend of the world becomes an enemy of God.
verses.textEnEsv: You adulterous people! Do you not know that friendship with the world is enmity with God? Therefore whoever wishes to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Adulterers and adulteresses! Do you not know that friendship with the world is enmity with God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.
verses.textEnNlt: You adulterers! Don’t you realize that friendship with the world makes you an enemy of God? I say it again: If you want to be a friend of the world, you make yourself an enemy of God.
verses.textEnNasb: You adulteresses, do you not know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Therefore whoever wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.
verses.textEn: You adulterous people, don’t you know that friendship with the world means enmity against God? Therefore, anyone who chooses to be a friend of the world becomes an enemy of God.

verses.textZh: 圣经说："神爱他那安置在我们里面的灵，爱到嫉妒的地步" ，你们想这话是徒然的吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 圣经说："神爱他那安置在我们里面的灵，爱到嫉妒的地步" ，你们想这话是徒然的吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们想经上所说是徒然的吗？神所赐、住在我们里面的灵，是恋爱至于嫉妒吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Or do you think Scripture says without reason that he jealously longs for the spirit he has caused to dwell in us ?
verses.textEnEsv: Or do you suppose it is to no purpose that the Scripture says, "He yearns jealously over the spirit that he has made to dwell in us"?
verses.textEnNkjv: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, "The Spirit who dwells in us yearns jealously"?
verses.textEnNlt: Do you think the Scriptures have no meaning? They say that God is passionate that the spirit he has placed within us should be faithful to him.
verses.textEnNasb: Or do you think that the Scripture says to no purpose, " He jealously desires the Spirit whom He has made to dwell in us"?
verses.textEn: Or do you think Scripture says without reason that he jealously longs for the spirit he has caused to dwell in us ?

verses.textZh: 但神所赐的恩更大；所以圣经上说： "神抵挡骄傲的人， 赐恩给谦卑的人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但神所赐的恩更大；所以圣经上说： "神抵挡骄傲的人， 赐恩给谦卑的人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但他赐更多的恩典，所以经上说：神阻挡骄傲的人， 赐恩给谦卑的人。
verses.textEnNiv: But he gives us more grace. That is why Scripture says: "God opposes the proud but shows favor to the humble."
verses.textEnEsv: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, "God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble."
verses.textEnNkjv: But He gives more grace. Therefore He says: "God resists the proud, But gives grace to the humble."
verses.textEnNlt: And he gives grace generously. As the Scriptures say, "God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble."
verses.textEnNasb: But He gives a greater grace. Therefore it says, "God is opposed to the proud, but gives grace to the humble."
verses.textEn: But he gives us more grace. That is why Scripture says: "God opposes the proud but shows favor to the humble."

verses.textZh: 你们应当顺服神，抵挡魔鬼，魔鬼就逃避你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们应当顺服神，抵挡魔鬼，魔鬼就逃避你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 故此，你们要顺服神。务要抵挡魔鬼，魔鬼就必离开你们逃跑了。
verses.textEnNiv: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
verses.textEnEsv: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore submit to God. Resist the devil and he will flee from you.
verses.textEnNlt: So humble yourselves before God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
verses.textEnNasb: Submit therefore to God. But resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
verses.textEn: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

verses.textZh: 你们应当亲近神，神就亲近你们。罪人啊，要洁净你们的手；三心两意的人哪，要清洁你们的心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们应当亲近神，神就亲近你们。罪人啊，要洁净你们的手；三心两意的人哪，要清洁你们的心。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们亲近神，神就必亲近你们。有罪的人哪，要洁净你们的手！心怀二意的人哪，要清洁你们的心！
verses.textEnNiv: Come near to God and he will come near to you. Wash your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.
verses.textEnEsv: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.
verses.textEnNkjv: Draw near to God and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners; and purify your hearts, you double-minded.
verses.textEnNlt: Come close to God, and God will come close to you. Wash your hands, you sinners; purify your hearts, for your loyalty is divided between God and the world.
verses.textEnNasb: Come close to God and He will come close to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners; and purify your hearts, you double-minded.
verses.textEn: Come near to God and he will come near to you. Wash your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.

verses.textZh: 你们要愁苦、悲哀、哭泣，把欢笑变为伤痛，把快乐变为忧愁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要愁苦、悲哀、哭泣，把欢笑变为伤痛，把快乐变为忧愁。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要愁苦、悲哀、哭泣，将喜笑变作悲哀，欢乐变作愁闷。
verses.textEnNiv: Grieve, mourn and wail. Change your laughter to mourning and your joy to gloom.
verses.textEnEsv: Be wretched and mourn and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lament and mourn and weep! Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom.
verses.textEnNlt: Let there be tears for what you have done. Let there be sorrow and deep grief. Let there be sadness instead of laughter, and gloom instead of joy.
verses.textEnNasb: Be miserable, and mourn, and weep; let your laughter be turned into mourning, and your joy into gloom.
verses.textEn: Grieve, mourn and wail. Change your laughter to mourning and your joy to gloom.

verses.textZh: 你们务要在主面前谦卑，他就使你们高升。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们务要在主面前谦卑，他就使你们高升。
verses.textZhCuv: 务要在主面前自卑，主就必叫你们升高。
verses.textEnNiv: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and he will lift you up.
verses.textEnEsv: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and he will exalt you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and He will lift you up.
verses.textEnNlt: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and he will lift you up in honor.
verses.textEnNasb: Humble yourselves in the presence of the Lord, and He will exalt you.
verses.textEn: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and he will lift you up.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，不要互相毁谤；人若毁谤弟兄，或判断弟兄，就是毁谤律法、判断律法了。如果你判断律法，就不是实行律法的人，而是审判官了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，不要互相毁谤；人若毁谤弟兄，或判断弟兄，就是毁谤律法、判断律法了。如果你判断律法，就不是实行律法的人，而是审判官了。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，你们不可彼此批评。人若批评弟兄，论断弟兄，就是批评律法，论断律法。你若论断律法，就不是遵行律法，乃是判断人的。
verses.textEnNiv: Brothers and sisters, do not slander one another. Anyone who speaks against a brother or sister or judges them speaks against the law and judges it. When you judge the law, you are not keeping it, but sitting in judgment on it.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not speak evil against one another, brothers. The one who speaks against a brother or judges his brother, speaks evil against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not speak evil of one another, brethren. He who speaks evil of a brother and judges his brother, speaks evil of the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t speak evil against each other, dear brothers and sisters. If you criticize and judge each other, then you are criticizing and judging God’s law. But your job is to obey the law, not to judge whether it applies to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not speak against one another, brothers and sisters. The one who speaks against a brother or sister, or judges his brother or sister, speaks against the law and judges the law; but if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge of it.
verses.textEn: Brothers and sisters, do not slander one another. Anyone who speaks against a brother or sister or judges them speaks against the law and judges it. When you judge the law, you are not keeping it, but sitting in judgment on it.

verses.textZh: 立法的，审判的，只有一位，就是那能拯救人，也能毁灭人的神；你这判断邻舍的，你是谁呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 立法的，审判的，只有一位，就是那能拯救人，也能毁灭人的神；你这判断邻舍的，你是谁呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 设立律法和判断人的，只有一位，就是那能救人也能灭人的。你是谁，竟敢论断别人呢？
verses.textEnNiv: There is only one Lawgiver and Judge, the one who is able to save and destroy. But you—who are you to judge your neighbor?
verses.textEnEsv: There is only one lawgiver and judge, he who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge your neighbor?
verses.textEnNkjv: There is one Lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. Who are you to judge another?
verses.textEnNlt: God alone, who gave the law, is the Judge. He alone has the power to save or to destroy. So what right do you have to judge your neighbor?
verses.textEnNasb: There is only one Lawgiver and Judge, the One who is able to save and to destroy; but who are you, judging your neighbor?
verses.textEn: There is only one Lawgiver and Judge, the one who is able to save and destroy. But you—who are you to judge your neighbor?

verses.textZh: 你们说："今天或明天，我们要到某城去，在那里住一年，作生意赚钱。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们说："今天或明天，我们要到某城去，在那里住一年，作生意赚钱。"
verses.textZhCuv: 嗐！你们有话说：「今天明天我们要往某城里去，在那里住一年，做买卖得利。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now listen, you who say, "Today or tomorrow we will go to this or that city, spend a year there, carry on business and make money."
verses.textEnEsv: Come now, you who say, "Today or tomorrow we will go into such and such a town and spend a year there and trade and make a profit"—
verses.textEnNkjv: Come now, you who say, "Today or tomorrow we will go to such and such a city, spend a year there, buy and sell, and make a profit";
verses.textEnNlt: Look here, you who say, "Today or tomorrow we are going to a certain town and will stay there a year. We will do business there and make a profit."
verses.textEnNasb: Come now, you who say, "Today or tomorrow we will go to such and such a city, and spend a year there and engage in business and make a profit."
verses.textEn: Now listen, you who say, "Today or tomorrow we will go to this or that city, spend a year there, carry on business and make money."

verses.textZh: 其实明天怎样，你们并不知道。你们的生命是甚么呢？你们本来是过眼云烟，转瞬之间就消逝了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其实明天怎样，你们并不知道。你们的生命是甚么呢？你们本来是过眼云烟，转瞬之间就消逝了。
verses.textZhCuv: 其实明天如何，你们还不知道。你们的生命是什么呢？你们原来是一片云雾，出现少时就不见了。
verses.textEnNiv: Why, you do not even know what will happen tomorrow. What is your life? You are a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes.
