verses.textEnEsv: yet you do not know what tomorrow will bring. What is your life? For you are a mist that appears for a little time and then vanishes.
verses.textEnNkjv: whereas you do not know what willhappen tomorrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapor that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.
verses.textEnNlt: How do you know what your life will be like tomorrow? Your life is like the morning fog—it’s here a little while, then it’s gone.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet you do not know what your life will be like tomorrow. For you are just a vapor that appears for a little while, and then vanishes away.
verses.textEn: Why, you do not even know what will happen tomorrow. What is your life? You are a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes.

verses.textZh: 你们倒不如说："主若愿意，我们就可以活着，作这事或作那事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们倒不如说："主若愿意，我们就可以活着，作这事或作那事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们只当说：「主若愿意，我们就可以活着，也可以做这事，或做那事。」
verses.textEnNiv: Instead, you ought to say, "If it is the Lord’s will, we will live and do this or that."
verses.textEnEsv: Instead you ought to say, "If the Lord wills, we will live and do this or that."
verses.textEnNkjv: Instead you ought to say, "If the Lord wills, we shall live and do this or that."
verses.textEnNlt: What you ought to say is, "If the Lord wants us to, we will live and do this or that."
verses.textEnNasb: Instead, you ought to say, "If the Lord wills, we will live and also do this or that."
verses.textEn: Instead, you ought to say, "If it is the Lord’s will, we will live and do this or that."

verses.textZh: 但现在你们竟然张狂自夸；这一切自夸，都是邪恶的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但现在你们竟然张狂自夸；这一切自夸，都是邪恶的。
verses.textZhCuv: 现今你们竟以张狂夸口；凡这样夸口都是恶的。
verses.textEnNiv: As it is, you boast in your arrogant schemes. All such boasting is evil.
verses.textEnEsv: As it is, you boast in your arrogance. All such boasting is evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: But now you boast in your arrogance. All such boasting is evil.
verses.textEnNlt: Otherwise you are boasting about your own pretentious plans, and all such boasting is evil.
verses.textEnNasb: But as it is, you boast in your arrogance; all such boasting is evil.
verses.textEn: As it is, you boast in your arrogant schemes. All such boasting is evil.

verses.textZh: 人若知道该行善事，却不去行，这就是他的罪了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人若知道该行善事，却不去行，这就是他的罪了。
verses.textZhCuv: 人若知道行善，却不去行，这就是他的罪了。
verses.textEnNiv: If anyone, then, knows the good they ought to do and doesn’t do it, it is sin for them.
verses.textEnEsv: So whoever knows the right thing to do and fails to do it, for him it is sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, to him who knows to do good and does not do it, to him it is sin.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember, it is sin to know what you ought to do and then not do it.
verses.textEnNasb: So for one who knows the right thing to do and does not do it, for him it is sin.
verses.textEn: If anyone, then, knows the good they ought to do and doesn’t do it, it is sin for them.

verses.textZh: 你们富有的人哪，应当为那将要临到你们的灾祸哭泣哀号。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们富有的人哪，应当为那将要临到你们的灾祸哭泣哀号。
verses.textZhCuv: 嗐！你们这些富足人哪，应当哭泣、号咷，因为将有苦难临到你们身上。
verses.textEnNiv: Now listen, you rich people, weep and wail because of the misery that is coming on you.
verses.textEnEsv: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for the miseries that are coming upon you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming upon you!
verses.textEnNlt: Look here, you rich people: Weep and groan with anguish because of all the terrible troubles ahead of you.
verses.textEnNasb: Come now, you rich people, weep and howl for your miseries which are coming upon you.
verses.textEn: Now listen, you rich people, weep and wail because of the misery that is coming on you.

verses.textZh: 你们的财物朽坏了，你们的衣服给蛀了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们的财物朽坏了，你们的衣服给蛀了，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们的财物坏了，衣服也被虫子咬了。
verses.textEnNiv: Your wealth has rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.
verses.textEnEsv: Your riches have rotted and your garments are moth-eaten.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are moth-eaten.
verses.textEnNlt: Your wealth is rotting away, and your fine clothes are moth-eaten rags.
verses.textEnNasb: Your riches have rotted and your garments have become moth-eaten.
verses.textEn: Your wealth has rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.

verses.textZh: 你们的金银生锈，这锈要成为控告你们的铁证，又要像火一样吞吃你们的肉。你们竟然在这末后的日子积聚财宝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们的金银生锈，这锈要成为控告你们的铁证，又要像火一样吞吃你们的肉。你们竟然在这末后的日子积聚财宝。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们的金银都长了锈；那锈要证明你们的不是，又要吃你们的肉，如同火烧。你们在这末世只知积攒钱财。
verses.textEnNiv: Your gold and silver are corroded. Their corrosion will testify against you and eat your flesh like fire. You have hoarded wealth in the last days.
verses.textEnEsv: Your gold and silver have corroded, and their corrosion will be evidence against you and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up treasure in the last days.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your gold and silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be a witness against you and will eat your flesh like fire. You have heaped up treasure in the last days.
verses.textEnNlt: Your gold and silver are corroded. The very wealth you were counting on will eat away your flesh like fire. This corroded treasure you have hoarded will testify against you on the day of judgment.
verses.textEnNasb: Your gold and your silver have corroded, and their corrosion will serve as a testimony against you and will consume your flesh like fire. It is in the last days that you have stored up your treasure!
verses.textEn: Your gold and silver are corroded. Their corrosion will testify against you and eat your flesh like fire. You have hoarded wealth in the last days.

verses.textZh: 看哪，工人为你们收割庄稼，你们竟然克扣他们的工资；那工资必为他们呼冤；收割者的呼声，已经达到万军之主的耳中了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，工人为你们收割庄稼，你们竟然克扣他们的工资；那工资必为他们呼冤；收割者的呼声，已经达到万军之主的耳中了。
verses.textZhCuv: 工人给你们收割庄稼，你们亏欠他们的工钱，这工钱有声音呼叫，并且那收割之人的冤声已经入了万军之主的耳了。
verses.textEnNiv: Look! The wages you failed to pay the workers who mowed your fields are crying out against you. The cries of the harvesters have reached the ears of the Lord Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you kept back by fraud, are crying out against you, and the cries of the harvesters have reached the ears of the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you kept back by fraud, cry out; and the cries of the reapers have reached the ears of the Lord of Sabaoth.
verses.textEnNlt: For listen! Hear the cries of the field workers whom you have cheated of their pay. The cries of those who harvest your fields have reached the ears of the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, the pay of the laborers who mowed your fields, and which has been withheld by you, cries out against you; and the outcry of those who did the harvesting has reached the ears of the Lord of armies.
verses.textEn: Look! The wages you failed to pay the workers who mowed your fields are crying out against you. The cries of the harvesters have reached the ears of the Lord Almighty.

verses.textZh: 你们在世上穷奢极侈，养肥了自己，竟不知屠宰的日子到了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们在世上穷奢极侈，养肥了自己，竟不知屠宰的日子到了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们在世上享美福，好宴乐，当宰杀的日子竟娇养你们的心。
verses.textEnNiv: You have lived on earth in luxury and self-indulgence. You have fattened yourselves in the day of slaughter.
verses.textEnEsv: You have lived on the earth in luxury and in self-indulgence. You have fattened your hearts in a day of slaughter.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have lived on the earth in pleasure and luxury; you have fattened your hearts as in a day of slaughter.
verses.textEnNlt: You have spent your years on earth in luxury, satisfying your every desire. You have fattened yourselves for the day of slaughter.
verses.textEnNasb: You have lived for pleasure on the earth and lived luxuriously; you have fattened your hearts in a day of slaughter.
verses.textEn: You have lived on earth in luxury and self-indulgence. You have fattened yourselves in the day of slaughter.

verses.textZh: 你们把义人定罪杀害，但他并没有反抗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们把义人定罪杀害，但他并没有反抗。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们定了义人的罪，把他杀害，他也不抵挡你们。
verses.textEnNiv: You have condemned and murdered the innocent one, who was not opposing you.
verses.textEnEsv: You have condemned and murdered the righteous person. He does not resist you.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have condemned, you have murdered the just; he does not resist you.
verses.textEnNlt: You have condemned and killed innocent people, who do not resist you.
verses.textEnNasb: You have condemned and put to death the righteous person; he offers you no resistance.
verses.textEn: You have condemned and murdered the innocent one, who was not opposing you.

verses.textZh: 所以，弟兄们，你们应当忍耐，直到主来。看哪，农夫等待着地里宝贵的出产，为它忍耐，直到获得秋霖春雨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，弟兄们，你们应当忍耐，直到主来。看哪，农夫等待着地里宝贵的出产，为它忍耐，直到获得秋霖春雨。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们哪，你们要忍耐，直到主来。看哪，农夫忍耐等候地里宝贵的出产，直到得了秋雨春雨。
verses.textEnNiv: Be patient, then, brothers and sisters, until the Lord’s coming. See how the farmer waits for the land to yield its valuable crop, patiently waiting for the autumn and spring rains.
verses.textEnEsv: Be patient, therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. See how the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient about it, until it receives the early and the late rains.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore be patient, brethren, until the coming of the Lord. See how the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, waiting patiently for it until it receives the early and latter rain.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear brothers and sisters, be patient as you wait for the Lord’s return. Consider the farmers who patiently wait for the rains in the fall and in the spring. They eagerly look for the valuable harvest to ripen.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore be patient, brothers and sisters, until the coming of the Lord. The farmer waits for the precious produce of the soil, being patient about it, until it gets the early and late rains.
verses.textEn: Be patient, then, brothers and sisters, until the Lord’s coming. See how the farmer waits for the land to yield its valuable crop, patiently waiting for the autumn and spring rains.

verses.textZh: 你们也应当忍耐，坚定自己的心；因为主再来的日子近了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们也应当忍耐，坚定自己的心；因为主再来的日子近了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们也当忍耐，坚固你们的心，因为主来的日子近了。
verses.textEnNiv: You too, be patient and stand firm, because the Lord’s coming is near.
verses.textEnEsv: You also, be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.
verses.textEnNlt: You, too, must be patient. Take courage, for the coming of the Lord is near.
verses.textEnNasb: You too be patient; strengthen your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is near.
verses.textEn: You too, be patient and stand firm, because the Lord’s coming is near.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，不要彼此抱怨，免得你们受审判。看哪，审判的主已经站在门前了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，不要彼此抱怨，免得你们受审判。看哪，审判的主已经站在门前了。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，你们不要彼此埋怨，免得受审判。看哪，审判的主站在门前了。
verses.textEnNiv: Don’t grumble against one another, brothers and sisters, or you will be judged. The Judge is standing at the door!
verses.textEnEsv: Do not grumble against one another, brothers, so that you may not be judged; behold, the Judge is standing at the door.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not grumble against one another, brethren, lest you be condemned. Behold, the Judge is standing at the door!
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t grumble about each other, brothers and sisters, or you will be judged. For look—the Judge is standing at the door!
verses.textEnNasb: Do not complain, brothers and sisters, against one another, so that you may not be judged; behold, the Judge is standing right at the door.
verses.textEn: Don’t grumble against one another, brothers and sisters, or you will be judged. The Judge is standing at the door!

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，你们应当效法奉主的名说话的先知，以他们为受苦忍耐的榜样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，你们应当效法奉主的名说话的先知，以他们为受苦忍耐的榜样。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，你们要把那先前奉主名说话的众先知当作能受苦能忍耐的榜样。
verses.textEnNiv: Brothers and sisters, as an example of patience in the face of suffering, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: As an example of suffering and patience, brothers, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: My brethren, take the prophets, who spoke in the name of the Lord, as an example of suffering and patience.
verses.textEnNlt: For examples of patience in suffering, dear brothers and sisters, look at the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: As an example, brothers and sisters, of suffering and patience, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Brothers and sisters, as an example of patience in the face of suffering, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

verses.textZh: 看哪，那些忍耐的人，我们称他们是有福的；你们听过约伯的忍耐，也看见了主赐给他的结局，知道主是满有怜悯和仁慈的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，那些忍耐的人，我们称他们是有福的；你们听过约伯的忍耐，也看见了主赐给他的结局，知道主是满有怜悯和仁慈的。
verses.textZhCuv: 那先前忍耐的人，我们称他们是有福的。你们听见过约伯的忍耐，也知道主给他的结局，明显主是满心怜悯，大有慈悲。
verses.textEnNiv: As you know, we count as blessed those who have persevered. You have heard of Job’s perseverance and have seen what the Lord finally brought about. The Lord is full of compassion and mercy.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, we consider those blessed who remained steadfast. You have heard of the steadfastness of Job, and you have seen the purpose of the Lord, how the Lord is compassionate and merciful.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed we count them blessed who endure. You have heard of the perseverance of Job and seen the end intendedby the Lord—that the Lord is very compassionate and merciful.
verses.textEnNlt: We give great honor to those who endure under suffering. For instance, you know about Job, a man of great endurance. You can see how the Lord was kind to him at the end, for the Lord is full of tenderness and mercy.
verses.textEnNasb: We count those blessed who endured. You have heard of the endurance of Job and have seen the outcome of the Lord’s dealings, that the Lord is full of compassion and is merciful.
verses.textEn: As you know, we count as blessed those who have persevered. You have heard of Job’s perseverance and have seen what the Lord finally brought about. The Lord is full of compassion and mercy.

verses.textZh: 我的弟兄们，最要紧的是不可起誓：不可指着天起誓，也不可指着地起誓，任何的誓都当禁绝。你们的话，是就说是，不是就说不是；免得你们落在审判之下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的弟兄们，最要紧的是不可起誓：不可指着天起誓，也不可指着地起誓，任何的誓都当禁绝。你们的话，是就说是，不是就说不是；免得你们落在审判之下。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的弟兄们，最要紧的是不可起誓；不可指着天起誓，也不可指着地起誓，无论何誓都不可起。你们说话，是，就说是；不是，就说不是，免得你们落在审判之下。
verses.textEnNiv: Above all, my brothers and sisters, do not swear—not by heaven or by earth or by anything else. All you need to say is a simple "Yes" or "No." Otherwise you will be condemned.
verses.textEnEsv: But above all, my brothers, do not swear, either by heaven or by earth or by any other oath, but let your "yes" be yes and your "no" be no, so that you may not fall under condemnation.
verses.textEnNkjv: But above all, my brethren, do not swear, either by heaven or by earth or with any other oath. But let your "Yes" be "Yes," and your "No," "No," lest you fall into judgment.
verses.textEnNlt: But most of all, my brothers and sisters, never take an oath, by heaven or earth or anything else. Just say a simple yes or no, so that you will not sin and be condemned.
verses.textEnNasb: But above all, my brothers and sisters, do not swear, either by heaven or by earth or with any other oath; but your yes is to be yes, and your no, no, so that you do not fall under judgment.
verses.textEn: Above all, my brothers and sisters, do not swear—not by heaven or by earth or by anything else. All you need to say is a simple "Yes" or "No." Otherwise you will be condemned.

verses.textZh: 你们中间有人受苦吗？他就应该祷告。有人心情愉快吗？他就应该歌颂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们中间有人受苦吗？他就应该祷告。有人心情愉快吗？他就应该歌颂。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们中间有受苦的呢，他就该祷告；有喜乐的呢，他就该歌颂。
verses.textEnNiv: Is anyone among you in trouble? Let them pray. Is anyone happy? Let them sing songs of praise.
verses.textEnEsv: Is anyone among you suffering? Let him pray. Is anyone cheerful? Let him sing praise.
verses.textEnNkjv: Is anyone among you suffering? Let him pray. Is anyone cheerful? Let him sing psalms.
verses.textEnNlt: Are any of you suffering hardships? You should pray. Are any of you happy? You should sing praises.
verses.textEnNasb: Is anyone among you suffering? Then he must pray. Is anyone cheerful? He is to sing praises.
verses.textEn: Is anyone among you in trouble? Let them pray. Is anyone happy? Let them sing songs of praise.

verses.textZh: 你们中间有人患病吗？他就应该请教会的长老来，让他们奉主的名为他抹油祈祷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们中间有人患病吗？他就应该请教会的长老来，让他们奉主的名为他抹油祈祷。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。
verses.textEnNiv: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them and anoint them with oil in the name of the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: Is anyone among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the church, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: Is anyone among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the church, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Are any of you sick? You should call for the elders of the church to come and pray over you, anointing you with oil in the name of the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: Is anyone among you sick? Then he must call for the elders of the church and they are to pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord;
verses.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them and anoint them with oil in the name of the Lord.

verses.textZh: 出于信心的祈祷，可以使病人康复，主必叫他起来；他若犯了罪，也必蒙赦免。
verses.textZhCnvs: 出于信心的祈祷，可以使病人康复，主必叫他起来；他若犯了罪，也必蒙赦免。
verses.textZhCuv: 出于信心的祈祷要救那病人，主必叫他起来；他若犯了罪，也必蒙赦免。
verses.textEnNiv: And the prayer offered in faith will make the sick person well; the Lord will raise them up. If they have sinned, they will be forgiven.
verses.textEnEsv: And the prayer of faith will save the one who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. And if he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the prayer of faith will save the sick, and the Lord will raise him up. And if he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.
verses.textEnNlt: Such a prayer offered in faith will heal the sick, and the Lord will make you well. And if you have committed any sins, you will be forgiven.
verses.textEnNasb: and the prayer of faith will restore the one who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up, and if he has committed sins, they will be forgiven him.
verses.textEn: And the prayer offered in faith will make the sick person well; the Lord will raise them up. If they have sinned, they will be forgiven.

verses.textZh: 所以你们应当彼此认罪，互相代求，这样你们就可以痊愈。义人祈祷所发出的力量，是大有功效的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你们应当彼此认罪，互相代求，这样你们就可以痊愈。义人祈祷所发出的力量，是大有功效的。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你们要彼此认罪，互相代求，使你们可以得医治。义人祈祷所发的力量是大有功效的。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed. The prayer of a righteous person is powerful and effective.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The prayer of a righteous person has great power as it is working.
verses.textEnNkjv: Confess your trespasses to one another, and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The effective, fervent prayer of a righteous man avails much.
verses.textEnNlt: Confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed. The earnest prayer of a righteous person has great power and produces wonderful results.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, confess your sins to one another, and pray for one another so that you may be healed. A prayer of a righteous person, when it is brought about, can accomplish much.
verses.textEn: Therefore confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed. The prayer of a righteous person is powerful and effective.

verses.textZh: 以利亚是与我们性情相同的人；他恳切祈求不要下雨，地上就三年零六个月没有雨；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚是与我们性情相同的人；他恳切祈求不要下雨，地上就三年零六个月没有雨；
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚与我们是一样性情的人，他恳切祷告，求不要下雨，雨就三年零六个月不下在地上。
verses.textEnNiv: Elijah was a human being, even as we are. He prayed earnestly that it would not rain, and it did not rain on the land for three and a half years.
verses.textEnEsv: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed fervently that it might not rain, and for three years and six months it did not rain on the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it would not rain; and it did not rain on the land for three years and six months.
verses.textEnNlt: Elijah was as human as we are, and yet when he prayed earnestly that no rain would fall, none fell for three and a half years!
verses.textEnNasb: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it would not rain, and it did not rain on the earth for three years and six months.
verses.textEn: Elijah was a human being, even as we are. He prayed earnestly that it would not rain, and it did not rain on the land for three and a half years.

verses.textZh: 他又祈祷，天就下雨，地就生出土产来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又祈祷，天就下雨，地就生出土产来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又祷告，天就降下雨来，地也生出土产。
verses.textEnNiv: Again he prayed, and the heavens gave rain, and the earth produced its crops.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he prayed again, and heaven gave rain, and the earth bore its fruit.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth produced its fruit.
verses.textEnNlt: Then, when he prayed again, the sky sent down rain and the earth began to yield its crops.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he prayed again, and the sky poured rain and the earth produced its fruit.
verses.textEn: Again he prayed, and the heavens gave rain, and the earth produced its crops.

verses.textZh: 我的弟兄们，你们中间若有人被骗离开了真道，如果有人使他回头，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的弟兄们，你们中间若有人被骗离开了真道，如果有人使他回头，
verses.textZhCuv: 我的弟兄们，你们中间若有失迷真道的，有人使他回转，
verses.textEnNiv: My brothers and sisters, if one of you should wander from the truth and someone should bring that person back,
verses.textEnEsv: My brothers, if anyone among you wanders from the truth and someone brings him back,
verses.textEnNkjv: Brethren, if anyone among you wanders from the truth, and someone turns him back,
verses.textEnNlt: My dear brothers and sisters, if someone among you wanders away from the truth and is brought back,
verses.textEnNasb: My brothers and sisters, if anyone among you strays from the truth and someone turns him back,
verses.textEn: My brothers and sisters, if one of you should wander from the truth and someone should bring that person back,

verses.textZh: 你们应该知道，那使罪人从歧途上转回的，就会拯救他的灵魂脱离死亡，也会遮盖许多罪恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们应该知道，那使罪人从歧途上转回的，就会拯救他的灵魂脱离死亡，也会遮盖许多罪恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 这人该知道：叫一个罪人从迷路上转回便是救一个灵魂不死，并且遮盖许多的罪。
verses.textEnNiv: remember this: Whoever turns a sinner from the error of their way will save them from death and cover over a multitude of sins.
verses.textEnEsv: let him know that whoever brings back a sinner from his wandering will save his soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and cover a multitude of sins.
verses.textEnNlt: you can be sure that whoever brings the sinner back from wandering will save that person from death and bring about the forgiveness of many sins.
verses.textEnNasb: let him know that the one who has turned a sinner from the error of his way will save his soul from death and cover a multitude of sins.
verses.textEn: remember this: Whoever turns a sinner from the error of their way will save them from death and cover over a multitude of sins.
